title: FederatedExchangeDocument
description: Federated exchange of digital cultural heritage objects in a loosely coupled network. Data model v0.1.0. Root type: full federation state snapshot (export/backup artifact, NOT the exchange unit). Exchange between nodes uses ExchangeEnvelope (see exchange-envelope.schema.json).

Uuid4.title: Uuid4
Uuid4.description: UUID v4, lowercase, immutable after assignment

TimestampRfc3339Utc.title: TimestampRfc3339Utc
TimestampRfc3339Utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with mandatory Z suffix (no arbitrary offset)

standard.description: Identifier of the exchange standard (protocol namespace)

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) of the exchange document

federation_nodes.description: Nodes (organizations) in the federation state snapshot. The snapshot is an export/backup artifact — the exchange unit between nodes is the ExchangeEnvelope, not this document

federation_node_guid.description: Globally unique (UUID v4), immutable, lowercase. Identifies the organization-node without a central operator

federation_node_url.description: Base URL of the node service (exchange endpoint)

digital_objects.description: Digital object cards owned by this node

persons.description: Persons (experts) registered at this node; owner node of each person is this FederationNode

license.description: Licenses applied by default to objects published by this node

digital_object_guid.description: Globally unique (UUID v4), immutable, lowercase. Assigned by the source organization

digital_object_media_url.description: URL of the digital representation (media) of the object. Optional: an abstract Work may have no digital representation yet (see rules object.media)

local_identifier.description: Local identifier of the object in the source organization, e.g. AK1

record_url.description: Canonical URL of the object record in the source organization's service

license.description: Licenses of the digital object (like classification — code + authority)

entity_type.description: Entity type: Work — abstract entity (the first registrar is the primary source of attributes); Manifestation — a realization of a Work; Item — a physical/local copy owned by a node

work_guid.description: Reference to the abstract Work entity (for Manifestation and Item)

owner_node_guid.description: UUID of the node owning the Item (for Item)

rights_holder_confirmation.description: Явное подтверждение правообладателя при регистрации работ, созданных третьими лицами (например, студенческих): исключает регистрацию чужой работы без ведома автора

code.description: Classifier code, e.g. group identifier of the universal classifier

authority.description: URI of the authoritative vocabulary (AAT, ULAN, LCSH, VIAF or a federation-registered classifier)

source_node_guid.description: UUID of the node that asserted this classification (provenance)

asserted_by_person_guid.description: UUID of the expert (Person) who performed the attribution. Scoped by source_node_guid (the node that asserted the classification)

key.description: Metadata attribute key, e.g. title, description, material

value.description: JSON scalar: string, number, or boolean

language.description: BCP 47 language tag, e.g. ru, en

authority.description: URI of the authoritative source defining the semantics of the attribute

source_node_guid.description: UUID of the node that asserted this attribute (provenance; enables conflict resolution during enrichment)

asserted_by_person_guid.description: UUID of the expert (Person) who asserted/attributed this attribute. Scoped by the attribute's source_node_guid: the person belongs to the same node

attribution_status.description: Verification level of the attribute: unverified, expert_verified, authoritative

is_enabled_for_ai_using.description: Allows using the attribute value in AI training data. Absent means not allowed (conservative default)

status.description: Статус атрибута: unresolved — заявления расходятся и конфликт не разрешён; canonical — достигнуто N≥2 независимых подтверждений или дефолт по fallback; rejected — отклонено

claims.description: Конкурирующие заявления по этому атрибуту; значение самого атрибута (value) — одно из заявлений, остальные — в claims

then.description: An attribute whose conflict status is declared (unresolved/canonical/rejected) must carry the competing claims it refers to

Person.title: Person
Person.description: Expert (attributor/verifier) registered at a node. Identity is node-scoped: person_guid is unique within the owner node; full identity is the pair (owner_node_guid, person_guid). There is no global person registry — consistent with the no-central-operator principle

owner_node_guid.description: UUID of the node owning this person record. In a FederationNode snapshot it is inherited from the containing node; in an ExchangeEnvelope it makes the ownership pair (owner_node_guid, person_guid) explicit (defaults to envelope sender_node_guid)

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the name

source_guid.description: UUID of the source node (FederationNode, DigitalObject or Person)

target_guid.description: UUID of the target node (FederationNode, DigitalObject or Person)

relation_type.description: Relation type. Base vocabulary: same_as (record linkage), duplicate_of; richer semantics are expressed by the authority URI, extensions land in the federation relation registry

authority.description: URI of the authoritative source defining the semantics of the relation type

status.description: Record linkage status: candidate_match, confirmed_match or rejected_match

asserted_by_node_guid.description: UUID of the node that asserted the relation (provenance)

confirmed_by_node_guid.description: UUID of the node that confirmed the relation (status confirmed_match). A status change is published as a new version of the same relation_guid with a later modified_at — the protocol layer keeps the history

modified_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp; later value than created_at signals a status update of the same relation_guid

NodeType.title: NodeType
NodeType.description: Types of relation endpoints. Work / Manifestation / Item are not separately addressable nodes: they are entity_type values of a DigitalObject card, so a relation between two heritage entities points at the cards with type DigitalObject (the card carries entity_type)

authority.description: URI of the authoritative source of the license (SPDX, Creative Commons, a registry of an organization, or a non-profit organization (NGO) as one possible variant)

source_node_guid.description: UUID of the node that asserted this license (provenance)

asserted_by_person_guid.description: UUID of the expert (Person) who asserted the license. Scoped by source_node_guid

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description: Конкурирующее заявление о значении атрибута с провенансом; атрибут хранится как множество claims, а не как единое каноническое значение

value.description: JSON scalar value of the claim

status.description: candidate — заявлено, не разрешено; canonical — после N≥2 независимых подтверждений; rejected — отклонено
